data.name: Murtazaah
data.gender_notes: Murtazaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is patient and kind, a protector. The name Murtazaah carries the meaning “Patient, kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Murtazaah usually hope their child will grow to embody patient, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a nurturing and compassionate soul, one who shows patience and kindness to all
data.etymology: Murtazaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patient, kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murtazaah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مرتضاة
in_arabic.long_meaning: مرتضاة هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه المختار، المرتضى من قبل الله، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: 'وَمُصطفىٰ وَمُرْتَضىٰ'، الآية ٣٩، ويعتبر من الأسماء ذات الدلالة الدينية والروحانية العميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: مرتضاہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کے ذریعہ منتخب شدہ، مرضی رکھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرتضاہ ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کے ذریعہ منتخب شدہ یا مرضی رکھنے والا۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة آل عمران میں ذکر ہوا ہے: 'وَمُصطفىٰ وَمُرْتَضىٰ'، آیت ٣٩۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں خاص دلچسپی اور روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں۔

in_hindi.name: मुर्तज़ाह
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर द्वारा चुना हुआ, प्रसन्नता प्राप्त करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुर्तज़ाह एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है ईश्वर द्वारा चुना हुआ या प्रसन्नता प्राप्त करने वाला। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत आले इमरान में वर्णित है: 'وَمُصطفىٰ وَمُرْتَضىٰ'، आयत ٣٩। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में विशेष आध्यात्मिक महत्व और पारंपरिक उपयोग रखता है।

in_pashto.name: مرتضی
in_pashto.meaning: د الله لخوا ټاکل شوی، د خوښۍ حامل
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرتضی د مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د الله لخوا ټاکل شوی یا د خوښۍ حامل معنی لري. دا نوم د قرآن کریم په سورت آل عمران کې ياد شوی دی: 'وَمُصطفىٰ وَمُرْتَضىٰ'، آیت ٣٩. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون اسلامی ثقافت کې ځانګړی مذهبی او روحاني اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Murtazaah
in_english.meaning: Chosen by God, one who gains satisfaction
in_english.long_meaning: Murtazaah is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It means 'chosen by God' or 'one who gains satisfaction'. The name is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Imran: 'وَمُصطفىٰ وَمُرْتَضىٰ', verse 39. Etymologically, it derives from the Arabic root 'r-d-h' which conveys the sense of being pleased or satisfied. Historically, the name holds significant spiritual and religious connotations in Islamic tradition, symbolizing divine selection and approval. Across Muslim cultures, Murtazaah is valued for its profound meaning and religious significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Murtazaah carries a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community. historically, it is most famously associated with Imam Murtaza, the fifth Shia Imam, who was known for his unwavering patience and strength in the face of adversity. His name serves as a reminder of the importance of perseverance and kindness within Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Murtazaah holds immense spiritual significance within Islamic culture as it encapsulates the ideal qualities of a true believer. The name denotes a protector, someone who shields and cares for those around them. In a spiritual sense, it is a reminder to strive towards becoming a better version of ourselves and to protect our own souls as well as the souls of those around us. This name, therefore, embodies the essence of compassion and selflessness, encouraging those who bear it to become beacons of light in their communities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Patient, kind" symbolizes One who is patient and kind, a protector. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Murtazaah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of patient, kind.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Murtazaah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Khadija Murtazaah, a teacher in Karachi, Pakistan, shares that their name Murtazaah meaning "Patient, kind" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
